message.content: Buddhism was founded by Siddhārtha Gautama—commonly known as **the Buddha**—in what is now modern-day Nepal/India around the 5th–4th centuries BCE. He attained enlightenment under the Bodhi tree near Lumbini (present‑day Nepal), and his teachings spread throughout ancient India before reaching other parts of Asia.
